source_of_truth.project_rules: The target repository root and applicable nested AGENTS.md files
source_of_truth.project_design: The target repository's declared design document
source_of_truth.task_state: The GitHub Issue and PR, when the repository uses them
source_of_truth.code: The target repository branch selected by its project rules

agent_file_resolution.shared_layer: The MAC-ENABLER managed block in the target root AGENTS.md
agent_file_resolution.conflict_policy: Project facts and validation rules stay project-local; shared workflow rules stay in mac-enabler. Do not guess when two rules conflict.

before_compaction: Save the handoff packet to the Issue or PR, or to the repository-approved durable location.
Record the selected route and model profile.
Record changed files, tests, failures, remaining work, and the exact next action.
Record unresolved choices instead of silently deciding them.
after_compaction: Read the target repository AGENTS.md again.
Confirm branch, PR, and working tree state.
Continue from the recorded next action; do not repeat discovery without a reason.

completion_gate: The requested scope is implemented or explicitly marked partial.
The target repository's required checks have been run or the omission is recorded.
Issue and PR references are correct.
Remaining work has an owner and a next action.
The handoff packet is durable before the context is compacted or handed off.
